maddeler.e:
نأتال (form VIII)
# نَأْتَالُ (naʔtālu) /naʔ.taː.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِئْتَالَ (iʔtāla)
# نَأْتَالَ (naʔtāla) /naʔ.taː.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِئْتَالَ (iʔtāla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
